name: Spreadsheet
note: The studio's work as a living data grid.
thesis: The portfolio AS a spreadsheet — a real, editable fancy-sheets workbook anchors the page, and every surface around it wears the same idiom: a green function-bar header, A1-style cell references as eyebrows, column-letter / row-number gutters, conditional-format status pills, in-cell data bars, ledger tables, and a status-bar footer with sheet tabs.

tokens.bg: #f6f7f5 app-chrome canvas behind the sheet; #ffffff cell paper; a faint 1px horizontal grid (30px rhythm) is painted into the page background so the whole document reads like ruled cells
tokens.fg: #18181b near-black cell ink (#3f3f46 body, #71717a metadata/row-numbers, #a1a1aa faint folios)
tokens.accent: #15803d spreadsheet green (the function/formula accent; #166534 pressed, #e8f1ea wash, #bcd2c0 border) — green = computed/live, never decorative
tokens.fontDisplay: var(--font-sans) — weight 650, tight tracking (-0.035em) on the hero; modest -0.02em on H2s
tokens.fontMono: var(--font-mono) — every cell reference, column header, row number, status pill, formula string, eyebrow, breadcrumb, and stat label is mono; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums page-wide
tokens.radius: 4px on containers (cells aren't round), 3px on chips/pills/inputs/avatars — crisp and near-square
tokens.border: 1px hairline #e4e4e7 grid lines; #d4d4d8 heavier rules; column/row headers filled #f1f3f0; 2px header underline; the live grid + every faux-grid use 1px gaps over a grid-colored background to fake true cell borders
tokens.motion: var(--dur-base)/var(--ease-out) only — background wash on row/tab/table-row hover, row-number turns green on hover, button color fades; no transforms, no shadows beyond a 1px seated edge

layout: A single centered 1180px column on an off-white, faintly grid-ruled canvas. The page opens with a full-width 'function bar' (ƒx box + breadcrumbs + a =STUDIO() formula + a name-box wordmark with an A1:F∞ range chip). Below it, every section is a bordered white 'cell range' card (4px radius, 1px grid border) opened by a mono A1-style cell-reference eyebrow. The hero is a 1.65fr/1fr split (headline + a 2×2 block of addressed stat cells). The centerpiece is a REAL fancy-sheets <SheetWorkbook> (project/discipline/year/status/fee, frozen header, a bottom =SUM/=COUNTIF formula row) inside a fixed-height framed pane. A hand-built faux reference grid (CSS-grid with 1px gaps, column-letter heads + a row-number gutter + stretched-link rows) re-presents the same data as a paged/filtered query. Capabilities live behind sheet-tab Tabs; About is a 0.32fr label beside a green-ruled cell-comment quote; the team is a roster sheet with utilization data bars; recognition is a ledger Table beside client range-tags; contact is a 1fr/1.05fr split (band Select + a =BRIEF() Card whose Composer is the cell editor). The footer is a status bar with sheet tabs. Collapses to 1-up at 920px; the faux grid drops its Discipline + Fee columns at 720px.

sections.name: function-bar (running head)
sections.what: A ƒx box, Breadcrumbs as a mono cell-trail, a =STUDIO("FIELDWORK", est:2016) formula string, and a name-box wordmark (gradient F mark) with an A1:F∞ range Badge.
sections.restyle: Breadcrumbs set in uppercase mono; Badge squared to a 3px mono conditional-format chip used as a cell-range tag. The whole bar is a white pane with a 1px seated edge — Excel's formula bar.

sections.name: hero
sections.what: A 'Sheet 00 · Cell A1' reference, a tight headline ('A design studio that runs on a grid.'), a lede, an 'Open a brief' + 'Jump to the data' button pair, and a 2×2 rail of addressed stat cells (B2..B5: active rows, =SUM(fees), shipped, studios).
sections.restyle: Display is sans weight 650 at -0.035em. Buttons become squared cell/toolbar buttons — primary = green fill with a 1px darker-green seated edge flipping darker on hover; ghost = white with a hairline that goes ink on hover. Stat cells are a 1px-gap grid with a tiny mono address in each corner and tabular numerals.

sections.name: workbook (the live grid)
sections.what: A real fancy-sheets <SheetWorkbook> of selected work (ID/project/discipline/year/status/fee), frozen header row, formula bar + bold + align toolbar, and a bottom row that is a real =SUM(F2:Fn) / =COUNTIF(E2:En,"Shipped") — editable, recomputes live. An 'Auto-calc' Switch and a save-status caption sit alongside.
sections.restyle: The workbook keeps its native zinc cell chrome (already spreadsheet-correct) but its blue selection/handles are recolored to spreadsheet-green via scoped attribute-selector overrides; the framed pane gets a 1px seated edge. Header row + total row are conditionally formatted green via per-cell CellFormat (backgroundColor/borderTop/color). Switch becomes a mono 'auto-calc' toggle.

sections.name: filtered index (faux grid)
sections.what: The same data re-presented as a hand-built grid: column-letter heads (A·ID … F·Fee €k), a row-number gutter, status as a Badge pill, fee with a € prefix, plus a status Select + discipline Pillbox filter and a row Pagination pager.
sections.restyle: Pure CSS-grid with 1px gaps over a grid-colored bg to fake cell borders; each row is one stretched Inertia <Link> (no nested anchors). Select + Pillbox squared to mono cell-inputs; Pagination numerals squared + mono; Badge → 3px mono conditional-format status pill (emerald/amber/zinc by status). Hover washes the row green and tints the row number.

sections.name: capabilities
sections.what: Underline Tabs (Services / Process / Notes) styled as sheet tabs: a 2-up services grid where each service is a referenced cell (A1..A4) with a capacity data bar, a Timeline process ledger with row-numbered dates, and an FAQ Accordion of cell notes (N1..N4).
sections.restyle: Tabs reskinned as physical sheet tabs — mono uppercase labels, header-fill inactive tabs with rounded-top borders, the active tab lifts to white paper and turns green, sitting on a 1px rail. Progress becomes a flat 2px-radius in-cell data bar (green fill). Timeline dates set mono uppercase. Accordion triggers carry a mono note reference.

sections.name: about (cell comment)
sections.what: A 0.32fr label column ('Cell comment' ref + an 'About' tag) beside a large lead statement and a supporting paragraph.
sections.restyle: The body is set off by a 3px green left rule — a spreadsheet cell-comment marker. Text reset to ink body at 1.65 line-height with no component chrome.

sections.name: team (roster sheet)
sections.what: A roster with a mono header row (Name / Role / Utilization) and a row per person: a square ink Avatar chip + name, role, and a utilization data bar with a mono percentage.
sections.restyle: Built as a 1px-gap grid 'sheet'. Avatar squared (3px) and recolored to a solid ink chip with white mono initials — the round portrait becomes a typographic name-cell mark. Progress is the green utilization data bar; rows wash green on hover.

sections.name: recognition
sections.what: An awards Table ledger (Year / Project / Award) beside a rail of client range-tags (Badges), a Separator, and a mono press list.
sections.restyle: Table flattened to a framed ledger — mono uppercase head with a 2px underline, 1px row hairlines, mono tabular year column, ink-weighted project column, green-washed row hover. Badges become squared mono header-fill cell-range tags. Press items get a green '›' formula-style bullet.

sections.name: contact (formula-bar input)
sections.what: An intro column (ref, 'Add a row.' heading, lede, mono contact lines, a budget-band Select that drives a ReasonTag + =BAND() readout) beside a bordered =BRIEF() Card: header with a ƒx box + an 'Open · Q3' status Badge, a Composer cell editor, a character Progress data bar, and a 'Commit row' Button; success swaps to a 'Row added' confirmation.
sections.restyle: The Card is a bordered cell range with a header-filled title bar reading =BRIEF(); Composer is the cell editor (1px grid border, green focus ring). Progress is the green character data bar. Select squared to a mono band picker. ReasonTag underline theme for the pricing rationale. Button primary = the green commit-row action.

sections.name: footer (status bar)
sections.what: A status bar: a strip of faux sheet tabs (Selected work / Roster / Awards / +) over a meta row with the fictional-studio line and a green 'Back to the gallery' link.
sections.restyle: All mono. Active sheet tab lifts to white with a 2px green top inset; the back link is the page's last green accent.

palette.restyle: The literal centerpiece — a real editable workbook. Per-cell CellFormat conditionally formats the header + total rows green; the package's blue selection/fill-handle is recolored to spreadsheet-green via scoped [class*="border-blue-500"]/[class*="bg-blue-500"] overrides; the pane is framed with a 1px seated edge. A bottom row carries real =SUM / =COUNTIF formulas.

Squared (4px) cell/toolbar buttons. Primary = green fill with a 1px darker-green seated edge, flips darker on hover, greys out disabled. Ghost = white with a hairline border that goes ink on hover. No rounded pill, no big shadow.

Reduced to a 3px squared mono chip and used three ways: a conditional-format STATUS pill (emerald=Shipped / amber=In build / zinc=Scoping), a header-fill client range-tag, and an A1:F∞ name-box range chip.
Framed ledger — mono uppercase head with a 2px underline, 1px row hairlines, mono tabular year column, ink project column, green-washed row hover.
Underline variant rebuilt as physical sheet tabs — header-fill rounded-top inactive tabs on a 1px rail; the active tab lifts to white paper and turns green; mono uppercase labels.
Squared (3px) and recolored to a solid ink chip with white mono initials — a typographic name-cell mark, not a portrait.
Flattened to a 2px-radius in-cell data bar with a green fill — used as service capacity, team utilization, and the brief character meter.
Squared mono numerals — a row pager under the faux grid.
Squared to mono cell-input fields with hairline borders; used as discipline tag-filter and status / budget-band pickers.
A mono 'auto-calc' toggle (emerald) sitting beside the live workbook.
A bordered cell range — 4px radius, 1px grid border, header-filled =BRIEF() title bar, hairline-divided footer, 1px seated edge instead of a drop shadow.
The cell editor — 1px grid border, sans body, green focus ring + wash.
A process ledger — mono uppercase row-numbered dates ('Rows 4–8 · System'); one green 'System' step, rest neutral.
Cell notes — each trigger prefixed with a mono note reference (N1..N4); hairline dividers, no fills.
Underline theme — an inline dotted-underline explainer for the indicative budget, in the mono metadata voice.
A mono uppercase cell-trail inside the function bar.
Collapsed to a single hairline between the client tags and the press list.
Reset to ink sans with tight tracking (display) / ink body at 1.65; component color presets overridden by scoped tokens.

contentArchetype: A one-page portfolio for FIELDWORK, a fictional Zürich/Lisbon design + dev studio, told entirely in spreadsheet grammar: a function-bar header, a hero with addressed stat cells, a REAL editable workbook of selected work (with live SUM/COUNTIF totals), a filtered/paged faux grid of the same rows, sheet-tabbed capabilities (services with capacity bars / a process ledger / FAQ notes), a cell-comment about statement, a utilization roster, an awards ledger + client range-tags + press, and an 'add a row' contact box with a =BRIEF() cell editor. Voice is terse, numeric, accountable; every label, reference, status, and total is mono.
remix: Keep the conceit literal: the page IS a workbook. Anchor with a real fancy-sheets <SheetWorkbook> carrying at least one genuine formula, and let everything else echo it — cell-reference eyebrows, column-letter + row-number gutters, conditional-format status pills, in-cell data bars, ledger tables, a status-bar footer. Hold the rules: ONE neutral ink + ONE 'computed' accent (green here; swap to any single saturated hue for another brand — blue reads most native), near-square 3–4px radius, mono for every reference/number/label, 1px-gap grids to fake cell borders, no shadows beyond a seated edge. To adapt to a SaaS/analytics product, swap the portfolio rows for live metrics and wire the workbook's onChange to a backend (fancy-query) and registerSheetsBridge so an agent can edit cells over MCP. Blend toward Mono by dropping the green to a single cobalt and squaring everything to radius 0; toward Product by letting the stat cells become real KPI cards — but the moment the grid stops being editable or the formulas stop computing, you've left Spreadsheet.
